symptom: Codex's built-in browser stayed off for every user whose ChatGPT Desktop declared node_repl in ~/.codex/config.toml, because the conflict check could not tell the user's own inert keys from a repository's injected settings.
rule: On a Browser registration conflict, read config/read layers; accept only allowlisted inert keys from the sole user layer that equal its values, replace args/env_vars explicitly, and refuse project, system and every other key. See git show 7b6eb9e6:agents/zstack/changes/codex-user-layer-node-repl.md.
